info.cls_ename: Department of Mechanical and Computer-Aided Engineering

description.describe_ch: 機動學是一門結合電腦、動力學、運動學、機械設計的整合性學科，其目的有二：（一）能用電腦來分析機構運動之原理，（二）能設計實用化，高效率的機構。課程實施將側重於電腦輔助運動學分析及設計。
description.describe_eh: Mechanisms is an interdisciplinary course that involving computers, Dynamics, Kinematics, and mechanical design. The purpose of this course is twofold: (1) To use computers in analyzing the principle of motion of mechanisms; and (2) to design an applicable and highly efficient mechanism. Teaching of Mechanisms will be emphasized on computer-aided kinematic analysis and synthesis.
description.pre_subname: PHYS1003普通物理(一)、ENGS1009應用力學(二)

targets.describe_ch: 能辨識出可應用機動學的工業產品，並能清楚表達
targets.describe_en: Distinguish and make clear statement where mechanisms can be applied in industry

targets.describe_ch: 能使用繪圖、數學分析及電腦技巧完成一工業機構的運動學分析
targets.describe_en: Be able to use graphical, analytical and computer techniques for analyzing kinematics of an industrial mechanism

targets.describe_ch: 有能力設計一安全、環保、低耗能的理想化機構
targets.describe_en: Be able to design a safe, environmental protected and energy efficient mechanism

targets.describe_ch: 能利用機動學的原理，評估一工程機構之效率，並提出改善的方法
targets.describe_en: Use principles of mechanisms to evaluate a mechanism and propose an improve method
